summary: Install verified Small Talk archives with one command and report source-pinned release versions.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Release archives contain st3, st linked to st3, and pty as their command payload. st3-migrate remains a separate source tool. Linux builds target glibc2.35 with pinned Zig0.15.2, avoiding newer weak-symbol version requirements. Native archive builds use a clean release stamp; ordinary local and Nix stamps retain their prior formats.

downtime.detail: The archive installer replaces binaries without restarting services. The one-line installer then invokes st; existing setup behavior determines startup.

manual.detail: Use the root install.sh for platform detection, download, SHA256 verification, installation and opening st. --tag selects a release; --no-run only installs. Extracted archive installers also accept --quiet. No gh, Rust, Nix or password prompt is required to download and install.

recovery.detail: No new persistent state changes. Existing source-pinned upgrade impact and rollback compatibility requirements continue to apply; retained older archives remain recovery material only when their state contracts permit rollback.
